edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest a small average effect that is directionally consistent but not dramatic.
edges.mechanism: This factor changes substrate delivery, microbial competition, short-chain fatty-acid production, or early-life colonization patterns in the gut. Those changes are most directly linked to LDL cholesterol when the endpoint is microbial composition, barrier function, or a gut-mediated immune phenotype.
edges.summary: In general adult, pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest that legumes tracks with lower ldl cholesterol. Most disagreement in the literature is about size, subgroup sensitivity, or dose threshold rather than about whether the relationship exists at all.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
